description: A remote_required profile MUST NEVER fall back to a local adapter: absence of a local adapter yields WAIT_CAPABILITY, never a fake local substitute. This vector routes a claim engaging remote_required profiles (literature, executable_ode_dae_sde_model, literature_extraction — all remote_required in the shipped catalog) and asserts the plan produces NO local step (adapter_id is null) for any remote_required profile. A remote_required profile with an adapter_id in the catalog still routes WAIT_CAPABILITY; the router refuses to engage the adapter locally.
